name: Grilled Lime Shrimp with Black Bean, Corn, Pepper & Tomato Salad

ingredients.name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: If using wooden skewers, place 8-12 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 limes
4 tomatoes
1 orange bell pepper
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Zest limes into a medium bowl and set aside for later use. Juice limes into a large bowl, then add oil, maple syrup, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp pure maple syrup
1 tsp oregano, dried
1 tsp garlic powder
salt
½ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Drain and rinse beans. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Rinse corn under hot water (from the tap) to thaw, then add to the bowl and set aside.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 680 g raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Add shrimp to the bowl with the lime zest, season with salt and pepper, then stir to coat.
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, thread shrimp onto the skewers and place on a plate. (If you don't have skewers, you can cook the shrimp directly on the grill pan.)
Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Working in batches if necessary, add skewers to the pan and cook, turning occasionally, until shrimp are cooked through, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, medium dice tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the beans and corn.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide shrimp skewers and salad between plates. Enjoy!
